C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

@[reducible] def toStruc [i : Nonempty M] (s : Structure L M) : Struc L := ⟨M, i, s⟩

end Structure

namespace Struc

instance (s : Struc L) : Nonempty s.Dom := s.nonempty

instance (s : Struc L) : Structure L s.Dom := s.struc

end Struc

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

end Structure

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

notation:max M:90 " ⊧/" e:max => Evalbm M e

abbrev Realize (s : Structure L M) : Formula L M →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] id
annotation: abbrev Realize (s : Structure L M) : Formula L M →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] id

C1_dependencies.name: id
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
The identity function. `id` takes an implicit argument `α : Sort u`
(a type in any universe), and an argument `a : α`, and returns `a`.

Although this may look like a useless function, one application of the identity
function is to explicitly put a type on an expression. If `e` has type `T`,
and `T'` is definitionally equal to `T`, then `@id T' e` typechecks, and Lean
knows that this expression has type `T'` rather than `T`. This can make a
difference for typeclass inference, since `T` and `T'` may have different
typeclass instances on them. `show T' from e` is sugar for an `@id T' e`
expression.
-/
@[inline] def id {α : Sort u} (a : α) : α := a

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

informal_statement: For any context `s`, expression `e`, and formula `φ` within a first-order logic framework involving matrices, the evaluation of `φ` with `k` bounded existence quantifiers is equivalent to there existing an extended expression `e'` such that the evaluation of the extended expression with `e'` matches the evaluation of `φ` without the bound.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we proceed by induction on `k`, the number of bounded existence quantifiers involved.

**Base Case (k = 0):**

When `k = 0`, there are no bounded existence quantifiers in the formula `∃^[0] φ`, which effectively reduces to `φ` itself. Therefore, the statement `Eval s e ε (∃^[0] φ)` simplifies to `Eval s e ε φ`. Consequently, the existence of an extended expression `e'` such that `Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' e) ε φ` is trivially satisfied by choosing `e'` as the empty matrix, as `Matrix.appendr` with an empty matrix means no extension is needed. Thus, the base case holds.

**Inductive Step:**

Assume that for some arbitrary natural number `k`, the statement holds:
```
Eval s e ε (∃^[k] φ) ↔ ∃ e', Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' e) ε φ
```
We now aim to show that the statement holds for `k + 1`, i.e.,
```
Eval s e ε (∃^[k+1] φ) ↔ ∃ e', Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' e) ε φ
```
By definition, `∃^[k+1] φ` is equivalent to `∃ x. ∃^[k] (λ y. φ ∧ y = x)`. Therefore, `Eval s e ε (∃^[k+1] φ)` becomes `Eval s e ε (λ y. ∃ x. ∃^[k] (λ y. φ ∧ y = x))`.

By applying the inductive hypothesis to `∃^[k] (λ y. φ ∧ y = x)`, we have:
```
Eval s (Matrix.appendr ([x]) e) ε (∃^[k] (λ y. φ ∧ y = x)) ↔ ∃ e', Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' (Matrix.appendr ([x]) e)) ε (λ y. φ ∧ y = x)
```
Simplifying further, we obtain:
```
∃ x, ∃ e', Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' (Matrix.appendr ([x]) e)) ε (φ ∧ y = x)
```
By choosing `e'` appropriately to satisfy `Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' (Matrix.appendr ([x]) e)) ε φ` and `Eval s (Matrix.appendr e' (Matrix.appendr ([x]) e)) ε (y = x)`, we ensure the existence of such an `e'`. Thus, the inductive step holds, and by the principle of mathematical induction, the statement is true for all natural numbers `k`.

**Conclusion:**

The equality of evaluation with bounded quantifiers to the existence of an extended expression satisfying the core formula demonstrates a fundamental property in the evaluation of quantified formulas within the given logical framework. This property ensures that the introduction of bounded existence quantifiers does not alter the semantic equivalence when extended expressions are considered, thereby maintaining the fidelity of the original statement under extension.

content_full:
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

end Structure

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop

  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))

  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

First, we consider the case when \( k = 0 \). By definition, there are no free variables, and the statement holds trivially since both sides of the equivalence represent the absence of any quantified statements.

Next, we assume that the equivalence holds for some arbitrary natural number \( k \). This means that a universal quantification over \( k \) free variables is equivalent to applying universal quantification \( k \) times.

We then consider the case when \( k + 1 \) free variables are present. By the induction hypothesis, any universal quantification over \( k \) free variables is equivalent to applying universal quantification \( k \) times. Extending this to \( k + 1 \) free variables, we first perform the universal quantification over the first \( k \) variables using the induction hypothesis, and then apply the universal quantification over the \( (k + 1)^{th} \) variable. This effectively results in applying universal quantification \( k + 1 \) times.

Thus, by induction, the equivalence holds for all natural numbers \( k \), thereby proving that the universal quantification over \( k \) free variables is equivalent to iterating universal quantification \( k \) times.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

informal_statement: For any formal evaluation context `ε`, the statement `∃* φ` evaluated in `ε` is equivalent to there existing an evaluation `e` such that `φ` is true in `ε`.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we proceed by induction on the structure of `n'`, typically involving natural numbers or similar structures. 

1. **Forward Direction**: Assume `Eval s e' ε (∃* φ)` holds. This means there exists an evaluation context `e'` such that under `s` and `ε`, `∃* φ` holds true. By the definition of `Eval` and `∃*`, there must exist an index `e` where `Eval s e ε φ` holds, thus proving the existence of such an `e`.

2. **Inductive Step**: We use the simp lemmas to handle the base case (when `n'` is zero) and the successor case (when `n'` is the successor of some `n`). 

   - **Base Case (n' = 0)**: Here, `Eval s e' ε (∃* φ)` simplifies directly, as there are no predecessors to consider. The condition reduces to checking the literal truth of `φ` under `ε`, which is straightforward.
   
   - **Successor Case**: Assuming the statement holds for `n'`, we extend it to `n' + 1`. If `Eval s e' ε (∃* φ)` holds for `n' + 1`, then by the induction hypothesis and the simp lemmas, there must exist an `e` such that `Eval s e ε φ` holds. This satisfies the inductive step, completing the proof.

3. Conversely, assume there exists an `e` such that `Eval s e ε φ` holds. By the arrangement of simp lemmas, `Eval s e' ε (∃* φ)` follows, thereby establishing the equivalence in both directions.

Thus, the equivalence `Eval s e' ε (∃* φ) ↔ ∃ e, Eval s e ε φ` holds for all relevant contexts `e'` and `ε`.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

@[reducible] def toStruc [i : Nonempty M] (s : Structure L M) : Struc L := ⟨M, i, s⟩

end Structure

namespace Struc

instance (s : Struc L) : Nonempty s.Dom := s.nonempty

instance (s : Struc L) : Structure L s.Dom := s.struc

end Struc

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

end Structure

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

informal_statement: For any two propositions \( a \) and \( b \), the conjunction \( a \land b \) is logically equivalent to \( b \land a \).
informal_proof:
Consider two arbitrary propositions \( a \) and \( b \). We aim to demonstrate that \( a \land b \) is equivalent to \( b \land a \) by proving both directions of the equivalence.

1. **Forward Direction (\( a \land b \rightarrow b \land a \))**:
   - Assume \( a \land b \) is true. By the definition of conjunction, this means both \( a \) and \( b \) are true.
   - Since \( b \) and \( a \) are both true, it follows that \( b \land a \) is also true.

2. **Reverse Direction (\( b \land a \rightarrow a \land b \))**:
   - Now, assume \( b \land a \) is true. Again, by the definition of conjunction, this implies both \( b \) and \( a \) are true.
   - Therefore, \( a \) and \( b \) are true, leading to the conclusion that \( a \land b \) is true.

Since both directions have been established, we conclude that \( a \land b \) is logically equivalent to \( b \land a \).

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

@[reducible] def toStruc [i : Nonempty M] (s : Structure L M) : Struc L := ⟨M, i, s⟩

end Structure

namespace Struc

instance (s : Struc L) : Nonempty s.Dom := s.nonempty

instance (s : Struc L) : Structure L s.Dom := s.struc

end Struc

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

end Structure

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

abbrev Evalbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (e : Fin n → M) :
    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := by exact?

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

@[reducible] def toStruc [i : Nonempty M] (s : Structure L M) : Struc L := ⟨M, i, s⟩

end Structure

namespace Struc

instance (s : Struc L) : Nonempty s.Dom := s.nonempty

instance (s : Struc L) : Structure L s.Dom := s.struc

end Struc

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :

  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])

    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h

    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

  toTr := EvalAux s ε e

  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalf s ε

    Semiformula L Empty n →ˡᶜ Prop := Evalb s e

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

/-!
# Semantics of first-order logic

This file defines the structure and the evaluation of terms and formulas by Tarski's truth definition.

-/

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language.{u}}

@[ext] class Structure (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) where
  func : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Func k → (Fin k → M) → M
  rel : ⦃k : ℕ⦄ → L.Rel k → (Fin k → M) → Prop

structure Struc (L : Language) where
  Dom : Type*
  nonempty : Nonempty Dom
  struc : Structure L Dom

abbrev SmallStruc (L : Language.{u}) := Struc.{u, u} L

instance : CoeSort (Struc L) (Type _) := ⟨Struc.Dom⟩

namespace Structure

instance [n : Nonempty M] : Nonempty (Structure L M) := by
  rcases n with ⟨x⟩
  exact ⟨{ func := fun _ _ _ => x, rel := fun _ _ _ => True }⟩

protected def lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (S : Structure L₂ M) : Structure L₁ M where
  func := fun _ f => S.func (φ.func f)
  rel := fun _ r => S.rel (φ.rel r)

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {M : Type w} (s₂ : Structure L₂ M)

@[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v := rfl

@[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v := of_eq rfl

def ofEquiv {M : Type w} [Structure L M] {N : Type w'} (Θ : M ≃ N) : Structure L N where
  func := fun _ f v => Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))
  rel  := fun _ r v => rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

protected abbrev Decidable (L : Language.{u}) (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] :=
  {k : ℕ} → (r : L.Rel k) → (v : Fin k → M) → Decidable (s.rel r v)

noncomputable instance [Structure L M] : Structure.Decidable L M := fun r v => Classical.dec (rel r v)

@[reducible] def toStruc [i : Nonempty M] (s : Structure L M) : Struc L := ⟨M, i, s⟩

end Structure

namespace Struc

instance (s : Struc L) : Nonempty s.Dom := s.nonempty

instance (s : Struc L) : Structure L s.Dom := s.struc

end Struc

namespace Semiterm

variable
  {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
  {e : Fin n → M} {e₁ : Fin n₁ → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M}
  {ε : ξ → M} {ε₁ : μ₁ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def val (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M
  | #x       => e x
  | &x       => ε x
  | func f v => s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε)

abbrev valb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (t : Semiterm L Empty n) : M := t.val s e Empty.elim

abbrev valm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiterm L ξ n → M := val s e ε

abbrev valbm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) : Semiterm L Empty n → M := valb s e

abbrev realize (s : Structure L M) (t : Term L M) : M := t.val s ![] id

@[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val s e ε (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = e x := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val s e ε (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = ε x := rfl

lemma val_func {k} (f : L.Func k) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f (fun i => (v i).val s e ε) := rfl

@[simp] lemma val_func₀ (f : L.Func 0) (v) :
    val s e ε (func f v) = s.func f ![] := by simp [val_func, Matrix.empty_eq]

@[simp] lemma val_func₁ (f : L.Func 1) (t) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

@[simp] lemma val_func₂ (f : L.Func 2) (t u) :
    val s e ε (func f ![t, u]) = s.func f ![t.val s e ε, u.val s e ε] :=
  by simp [val_func]; congr; funext i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i <;> simp

lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L μ₁ n₁ μ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val s e₂ ε₂ = t.val s (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val s e₂ ε₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar) :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, Rew.func, val_func]

lemma val_rewrite (f : μ₁ → Semiterm L μ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => (f x).val s e ε₂) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_rewriteMap (f : μ₁ → μ₂) (t : Semiterm L μ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val s e ε₂ = t.val s e (fun x => ε₂ (f x)) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.substs w t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => (w x).val s e₂ ε) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s (a :> e) ε = t.val s e ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

lemma val_bShift' (e : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val s e ε = t.val s (e ·.succ) ε := by simp [val_rew, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val s e ε = t.val s e i.elim := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr; { funext x; exact i.elim' x }

@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val s e₂ ε = t.val s (fun x => e₂ (x.castLE h)) ε  := by
  simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val s e ε = t.valb s (fun x ↦ (w x).val s e ε) := by
  simp [val_rew, Empty.eq_elim]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toS {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L (Fin n) 0) :
    valb s e (Rew.toS t) = val s ![] e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr

@[simp] lemma val_toF {e : Fin n → M} (t : Semiterm L Empty n) :
    val s ![] e (Rew.toF t) = valb s e t := by
  simp [val_rew, Matrix.empty_eq]; congr
  funext i; simp; contradiction

section Language

variable (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M)

lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val s₂ e ε = t.val (s₂.lMap φ) e ε :=
  by induction t <;> simp [*, valm, Function.comp_def, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func]

end Language

section Syntactic

variable (ε : ℕ → M)

lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val s e ε = t.val s e (ε ∘ Nat.succ) := by simp [val_rew]; congr

lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val s e (a :>ₙ ε) = t.val s (e <: a) ε :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr; exact funext $ Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val s (e <: a) ε = t.val s e (a :>ₙ ε) :=
  by simp [val_rew]; congr <;> simp [Function.comp_def]; exact funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

end Syntactic

lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? ε ε') :
    val s e ε t = val s e ε' t := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func]
  case fvar x => exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simp; exact ⟨i, hx⟩))

lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : val s e ε t = valb s e (t.toEmpty h) := by
  induction t <;> simp [val_func, Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

end Semiterm

namespace Structure

section

variable [s : Structure L M] (Θ : M ≃ N)

lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v)) := rfl

lemma ofEquiv_val (e : Fin n → N) (ε : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (ofEquiv Θ) e ε = Θ (t.val s (Θ.symm ∘ e) (Θ.symm ∘ ε)) := by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

end

end Structure

namespace Semiformula

variable {M : Type w} {s : Structure L M}
variable {n : ℕ} {e : Fin n → M} {e₂ : Fin n₂ → M} {ε : ξ → M} {ε₂ : μ₂ → M}

def EvalAux (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : ∀ {n}, (Fin n → M) → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | _, _, ⊤        => True
  | _, _, ⊥        => False
  | _, e, rel φ v  => s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, nrel φ v => ¬s.rel φ (fun i => Semiterm.val s e ε (v i))
  | _, e, φ ⋏ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∧ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, φ ⋎ ψ    => φ.EvalAux s ε e ∨ ψ.EvalAux s ε e
  | _, e, ∀' φ     => ∀ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))
  | _, e, ∃' φ     => ∃ x : M, (φ.EvalAux s ε (x :> e))

@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s ε e (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s ε e φ :=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, ←neg_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left]

def Eval (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) : Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop where
  toTr := EvalAux s ε e
  map_top' := rfl
  map_bot' := rfl
  map_and' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_or' := by simp [EvalAux]
  map_neg' := by simp [EvalAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp [imp_eq, EvalAux_neg, ←neg_eq, EvalAux, imp_iff_not_or]

abbrev Evalm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] {n} (e : Fin n → M) (ε : ξ → M) :
    Semiformula L ξ n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e ε

abbrev Evalf (s : Structure L M) (ε : ξ → M) : Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s ![] ε

abbrev Evalb (s : Structure L M) (e : Fin n → M) : Semisentence L n →ˡᶜ Prop := Eval s e Empty.elim

abbrev Evalfm (M : Type w) [s : Structure L M] (ε : ξ → M) :
    Formula L ξ →ˡᶜ Prop := by exact?
